alternative_hole_edge_drc.interpretation: Via/PTH/NPTH-to-track numbers interpreted as hole edge to track copper edge; pad-to-track and drilled-pad-to-drilled-pad are copper-edge gaps. Unclarified vendor interpretation, not accepted fabrication rules.
alternative_hole_edge_drc.rules:
(version 1)
(rule "Robu provisional via-hole-to-track"
 (condition "(A.Type == 'Via' && B.Type == 'Track') || (B.Type == 'Via' && A.Type == 'Track')")
 (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.254mm)))
(rule "Robu pad-to-track"
 (condition "(A.Type == 'Pad' && B.Type == 'Track') || (B.Type == 'Pad' && A.Type == 'Track')")
 (constraint clearance (min 0.2mm)))
(rule "Robu provisional PTH-hole-to-track"
 (condition "(A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && B.Type == 'Track') || (B.Type == 'Pad' && B.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && A.Type == 'Track')")
 (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.33mm)))
(rule "Robu NPTH-hole-to-track"
 (condition "(A.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'NPTH, mechanical' && B.Type == 'Track') || (B.Type == 'Pad' && B.Pad_Type == 'NPTH, mechanical' && A.Type == 'Track')")
 (constraint hole_clearance (min 0.254mm)))
(rule "Robu drilled-pad-to-drilled-pad"
 (condition "A.Type == 'Pad' && B.Type == 'Pad' && A.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole' && B.Pad_Type == 'Through-hole'")
 (constraint clearance (min 0.5mm)))
(rule "Robu different-net hole separation"
 (condition "A.Net != B.Net")
 (constraint hole_to_hole (min 0.5mm)))
(rule "Robu same-net via hole separation"
 (condition "A.Type == 'Via' && B.Type == 'Via' && A.Net == B.Net")
 (constraint hole_to_hole (min 0.254mm)))
